scenario.description: An assistant principal must finalize a six-week cell-phone policy pilot for the high school, including its grade scope, storage procedure, safety-plan exception, launch date, registration requirement, and implementation records, with input from a ninth-grade teacher, a school counselor, and the technology coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The high school is planning a six-week pilot to reduce classroom disruptions caused by student cell-phone use.
shared_context.S2: The draft proposal covers grades 9 and 10, suggests placing phones in open classroom bins, and lists September 2, 2026, as the tentative launch date.
shared_context.S3: Ms. Brooks has authority to approve the pilot's final scope, procedures, and launch record.
shared_context.S4: The weekly implementation meeting follows the agenda by receiving a report from the participating teacher, the counselor, and the technology coordinator before the proposal is approved.
shared_context.S5: The meeting secretary records each report, the approved policy choices, and the follow-up work assigned to staff in the meeting minutes.

PF1.text: Mr. Ellis's classroom trial with all 9th-grade sections recorded 23 phone-related interruptions in two weeks, while numbered locking pouches reduced interruptions; he recommended a grade-9-only pilot using one pouch per student in his team notes, but the notes have not been added to the draft proposal.

PF2.text: Two students have active safety plans requiring them to receive time-sensitive messages from their caregivers during the school day; Ms. Romero confirmed the plans with both families this week, but the exception has not been entered in the pilot procedure.

PF3.text: The student-information system's phone-registration module will not be ready until September 16, 2026, and the technology change plan requires the pilot to launch with a digital registration record on that date; Mr. Shah confirmed the deployment date with the district systems team this week, but the draft still shows September 2.

pilot_grade_scope.description: Use exactly 'Grade 9 only' for the approved scope.

phone_storage_method.description: Use exactly 'Numbered locking pouches, one per student' for the approved storage method.

safety_plan_exception.description: State that students with active safety plans requiring time-sensitive caregiver messages are exempt from the phone-storage procedure and retain access during the school day.

launch_date.description: Use exactly 'September 16, 2026' for the launch date.

registration_record_required.description: Whether a digital registration record is required at launch.

type.description: Use exact types 'classroom_storage_procedure' and 'digital_registration_record' for the corresponding commitments.

acceptance_conditions: The pilot must cover grade 9 only.
Phones must be stored in numbered locking pouches, one per student.
Students with active safety plans requiring time-sensitive caregiver messages must retain access to their phones during the school day.
The pilot must launch on September 16, 2026.
A digital registration record must be required at launch.
A classroom storage-procedure commitment must be recorded with the exact type classroom_storage_procedure.
A digital registration-record commitment must be recorded with the exact type digital_registration_record.

content_checks.C2: decisions['phone_storage_method'] == 'Numbered locking pouches, one per student'
content_checks.C3: 'active safety plans' in decisions['safety_plan_exception'] and 'time-sensitive' in decisions['safety_plan_exception'] and 'caregiver' in decisions['safety_plan_exception'] and 'retain access' in decisions['safety_plan_exception']

decisive_facts.why: The teacher's trial changes the scope from grades 9 and 10 to Grade 9 only, changes storage to numbered locking pouches with one pouch per student, and requires the classroom_storage_procedure commitment.
The two active safety plans change the exception from no listed exception to retaining phone access for time-sensitive caregiver messages, and require the counselor's spoken fact to be cited.
The confirmed module deployment changes the launch date from September 2 to September 16, 2026, makes a digital registration record required, and requires the digital_registration_record commitment.
